headline: Judge Orders Meta to Pay $25 Billion in New Mexico Privacy Case
summary: A US judge ordered Meta to pay New Mexico $25 billion after a jury found the company liable for deceiving users about Facebook privacy practices.
why: Meta is a leading digital advertising and social media giant facing major regulatory and legal liabilities over user data practices.

impacts.name: Meta Platforms
impacts.why: Substantial legal judgments impose direct financial costs and potential liabilities for technology platforms.

why_moved: Massive legal penalties directly impact corporate balance sheets and shareholder equity values.
